Class SelectBugemonFromTeamView

java.lang.Object
views.View<Controller>
views.SelectBugemonFromTeamView
public class SelectBugemonFromTeamView extends View<Controller>
View for the Bugemon switch sub-window displayed during a fight.

This view renders the player's team, shows HP popups on hover, and forwards selection and cancellation events to its associated Controller.
